patches.title: Bound MorphImages pixel-channel access
patches.description: Use the channel layout of the morph output image for output writes and read source pixels by channel, preventing out-of-bounds access when input frames have different channel layouts.

tests.baselineExpectation: Under Valgrind, the exact installed Debian Trixie baseline reports an invalid write from MorphImages when morphing the GrayscaleAlpha frame into the sRGB frame.
tests.patchedExpectation: The patched installed package processes the same frames with no invalid memory accesses and emits a three-frame result.
